subject.title: feat(openclaw): support pinning release version via openclaw_version

question: Should the installer officially support an `openclaw_version` release pin, including forced convergence from a development-mode command shadow to the pnpm-installed release?
rationale: The implementation appears bounded and proof-backed, but it adds public configuration and intentionally changes the development-to-release transition behavior; that support and compatibility contract requires repository-owner intent.

options.title: Sponsor version pinning
options.body: Accept exact release pins with `latest` as the backward-compatible default, then refresh the branch against current main and merge if integration remains clean.

options.title: Keep latest-only release mode
options.body: Decline the new configuration contract and close the proposal as an intentionally unsupported installer mode.

recommendation.title: Sponsor version pinning
recommendation.body: Accept exact release pins with `latest` as the backward-compatible default, then refresh the branch against current main and merge if integration remains clean.

likelyOwner.reason: No current-main provenance was available in the supplied review context; an installer configuration owner should make the product decision.
